-- Insert 5 basic operational form templates for CJB Workflow System

-- 1. Purchase Request (PR) Template
INSERT INTO workflow_templates (name, workflow_type, description, approval_stages, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  'Purchase Request (PR)',
  'PR',
  'Standard purchase request form for procuring goods or services from external vendors',
  JSON_ARRAY(
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 1, 'stage_name', 'Department Head Review', 'required_role', 'Department Head', 'description', 'Department head reviews and approves the purchase request'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 2, 'stage_name', 'Purchasing Review', 'required_role', 'Purchasing', 'description', 'Purchasing team reviews vendor selection and pricing'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 3, 'stage_name', 'Finance Review', 'required_role', 'Finance', 'description', 'Finance team reviews budget availability'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 4, 'stage_name', 'CFO Approval', 'required_role', 'CFO', 'description', 'CFO provides final approval for purchase')
  ),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- 2. Material Authorization Form (MAF) Template
INSERT INTO workflow_templates (name, workflow_type, description, approval_stages, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  'Material Authorization Form (MAF)',
  'MAF',
  'Authorization form for material usage, inventory withdrawal, or resource allocation',
  JSON_ARRAY(
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 1, 'stage_name', 'Department Head Review', 'required_role', 'Department Head', 'description', 'Department head reviews material request justification'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 2, 'stage_name', 'PPIC Review', 'required_role', 'PPIC', 'description', 'PPIC verifies inventory availability and production schedule'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 3, 'stage_name', 'Finance Review', 'required_role', 'Finance', 'description', 'Finance reviews cost implications'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 4, 'stage_name', 'CFO Approval', 'required_role', 'CFO', 'description', 'CFO provides final authorization')
  ),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- 3. Budget Request Template
INSERT INTO workflow_templates (name, workflow_type, description, approval_stages, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  'Budget Request',
  'Budget',
  'Request for budget allocation for projects, campaigns, or departmental expenses',
  JSON_ARRAY(
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 1, 'stage_name', 'Department Head Review', 'required_role', 'Department Head', 'description', 'Department head reviews budget justification and ROI'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 2, 'stage_name', 'Finance Review', 'required_role', 'Finance', 'description', 'Finance team reviews budget availability and financial impact'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 3, 'stage_name', 'CFO Approval', 'required_role', 'CFO', 'description', 'CFO approves budget allocation'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 4, 'stage_name', 'CEO Final Approval', 'required_role', 'CEO', 'description', 'CEO provides final approval for large budget requests')
  ),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- 4. Leave Request Template
INSERT INTO workflow_templates (name, workflow_type, description, approval_stages, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  'Leave Request',
  'Leave',
  'Employee leave application for vacation, sick leave, or personal time off',
  JSON_ARRAY(
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 1, 'stage_name', 'Department Head Review', 'required_role', 'Department Head', 'description', 'Department head reviews leave request and team coverage'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 2, 'stage_name', 'GA Approval', 'required_role', 'GA', 'description', 'GA verifies leave balance and company policy compliance')
  ),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- 5. Expense Reimbursement Template
INSERT INTO workflow_templates (name, workflow_type, description, approval_stages, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  'Expense Reimbursement',
  'Expense',
  'Claim reimbursement for business-related expenses (travel, meals, supplies, etc.)',
  JSON_ARRAY(
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 1, 'stage_name', 'Department Head Review', 'required_role', 'Department Head', 'description', 'Department head verifies expense legitimacy and business purpose'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 2, 'stage_name', 'Finance Review', 'required_role', 'Finance', 'description', 'Finance reviews receipts and calculates reimbursement amount'),
    JSON_OBJECT('stage_number', 3, 'stage_name', 'CFO Approval', 'required_role', 'CFO', 'description', 'CFO approves reimbursement payment')
  ),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);
